item.title: Abbotsford Property Market — Buying Guide
item.description:
The Abbotsford Property Market — What You Need to Know

Buying in Abbotsford is a significant financial decision. Here’s the reality of the market — not a sales pitch, not doom and gloom, just the facts and context you need to make a smart move.

See our Abbotsford Cost of Living guide for the broader picture.

What Kind of Property Can You Buy?

Abbotsford’s housing stock includes:

  • Apartments — New builds and established units. The entry point for most first-time buyers in Abbotsford. Quality varies enormously — inspect thoroughly.
